settings.label: Connect further DNS servers at login
settings.description: Reads the NS records of the zones and connects the other DNS servers found (e.g. further domain controllers) with the same login. Otherwise servers are added by hand.

settings.label: Check the server after login
settings.description: Starts the configuration check in the background after login.

settings.label: Query name servers and forwarders during the check
settings.description: Sends DNS queries (SOA, NS) to every name server of a zone and to the forwarders to compare serials and answers.

settings.label: Refresh automatically
settings.description: Checks at the chosen interval whether open zones were changed (SOA serial, also via the DNS console) and reloads them. Who changed it is shown from the server's audit log.

settings.label: DHCP server for the comparison
settings.description: Optional Microsoft DHCP server whose leases and reservations are compared with DNS. Empty = no comparison.

settings.label: Stored credentials
settings.description: Used when "Stored credentials" is selected at login. Stored encrypted in the vault.
